brief: OIS BoJ pricing more hawkish than Barclays forecast
statement: OIS market pricing of the BoJ path, at nearly 1.9% by July 2027, is more hawkish than Barclays' forecast of 1.75%.
evidence_texts: ["Amid hawkish comments from the BoJ officials and indicative comments from US Treasury Secretary Bessent on prospective hikes, the OIS market already prices almost quarterly rate hikes, taking the policy rate to nearly 1.9% by July next year (Figure 2), exceeding our forecast of hikes in September, January and July to 1.75%."]
argument_summaries: ["Further JPY appreciation may require a surprise relative to already hawkish BoJ pricing [S007]. OIS prices a rate near 1.9% by July 2027 [S033], above Barclays' 1.75% forecast [S034][S035]. Unless the BoJ signals quarterly hikes towards 2% [S036], JPY gains from a hawkish surprise would likely be limited [S037]. Signalling hikes beyond 2% could fuel JPY strength [S038] but is unlikely [S040], because 2% is the centre of BoJ neutral-rate estimates [S039]. Hike pricing likely strengthened the JPY via the risk premium too [S041], so a reversal could hit the JPY harder [S042]."]
